title: Sync V3 Immutable Global Snapshot
description: The complete authoritative state produced by the State Builder. It is the ONLY downlink data format; clients never receive remote fragments. stateHash is the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical hash of the `state` object only; envelope metadata (createdAt, serverInstanceId, broker sequences) is excluded so that replaying the same command stream always yields the same hash.

parentVersion.description: Snapshot version this one builds upon; 0 for the initial snapshot.

customLists.description: Only real user-defined lists. Inbox and Today are computed filter views and MUST NOT appear here.
